topic: Legarda-Leviste P10B solar ghost electricity plunder investigation vs. PrimeWater/Hiraya P6.7B corporate transfiguration
tweet1: Sen. Loren Legarda, her son Rep. Leandro Leviste, and ex-Energy Sec Alfonso Cusi face plunder charges over P10B solar 'ghost electricity' projects — same week Rappler asks if PrimeWater can rebrand to Hiraya to escape P6.7B in public distrust.
tweet2: @inquirerdotnet reports preliminary investigation ordered for Legarda, Leviste, Cusi on solar fraud allegations. Meanwhile, Rappler's Vantage Point asks: can corporate transfiguration wash away years of accountability questions? Pareho lang — bagong pangalan, same playbook.
tweet3: The pattern: face institutional scrutiny, either lawyer up for procedural delays (Legarda camp) or corporate makeover (PrimeWater→Hiraya). Both strategies bet the system forgets faster than it prosecutes. So far, they're right.
tweet4: If Legarda walks through preliminary investigation like Revilla walked out on P1M bail for P93M theft, then PrimeWater's rebrand wasn't desperate — it was precedent. Accountability theater runs on short attention spans. Sino ba talaga ang nakakulong from these mega-cases?
